claim: The curve states how tone MOVES across a chapter so grade, music and pace can interpolate between its ends rather than jumping at the cut. It is the difference between a chapter that is sad and a chapter that gets sad, and whiplash versus arc is entirely a claim about the journey.
not_visual: Purely temporal — it describes change between the start and end of a chapter. A still has no start and no end, so rising, falling, spiral and whiplash would all resolve to whatever single tone you happened to sample; every panel would be the same frame.
